widgets.text:
A accelerate, B brake
R handbrake for tight hairpins
L/R shift in manual
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Licensed rally machines with four-wheel drive and front/rear drive types.
4WD grips best on gravel; RWD slides more on snow.
widgets.label: Rally cars

widgets.text: Tune gearing, suspension and tyres for each surface.
widgets.label: Setup

widgets.text:
Rally stages are timed: every second lost in a ditch counts.
Use the handbrake into hairpins, then straighten before the throttle.
Snow and gravel need earlier braking than tarmac.
widgets.label: Stage tips

widgets.text:
Tarmac, gravel, dirt and snow stages.
Each rally is a set of stages; total time decides the winner.
widgets.label: Surfaces

widgets.text:
Winning unlocks new cars and parts.
Match tyres to the surface for the biggest gain.
widgets.label: Upgrades

widgets.text:
New cars appear as championships are won.
Hidden cars reward perfect seasons.
widgets.label: Cars

widgets.text:
Clear each rally class in Championship mode.
Beat stage times in Time Attack.
widgets.label: Goal
